text: {"lessons":["My account rose from 105,931 to 114,144, but without a benchmark or separating market gains from my decisions, I should not assume my trades caused the increase.","Selling some Stock D at a profit and Stock E at a loss does not by itself show whether those were good decisions; I should assess each trade against my plan and the portfolio’s overall return.","I repeatedly added to Stocks C and D and later sold portions of D, so I should check that trades keep my holdings diversified and aligned with my apartment goal rather than reacting to recent prices."]}
